task: Implement EventFrame architecture: binding layer that groups v9 entities+relations into coherent episodes with provenance, prev/next pointers, and topic-shift segmentation

assertions.text: EventFrame dataclass exists in storage.py with fields: id, turns, timestamp, gist, entities, facts, prev, next. EventFrameIndex provides add/get/get_by_turn/get_neighbors. Serializable via to_dict/from_dict.

segment_events() in ingestion.py groups turns into events by detecting topic shifts via entity overlap between consecutive turns. Not fixed-size: a single-topic 8-turn exchange = 1 frame, a 2-turn topic switch = 2 frames.

Foundry.ingest_turns() and ingest_chunk() build EventFrames after entity extraction. Each frame links to prev/next via doubly-linked list. FoundryStore.event_frames field populated. Gist = first turn text[:200] (no LLM call).
assertions.evidence: 10 tests passing. _build_event_frames() wired into ingest_turns() and ingest_chunk()

assertions.text: recall() in retrieval.py uses event frames for temporal contiguity: when BM25 retrieves a turn, look up its EventFrame, pull prev/next frame turns as bonus candidates (score * 0.1). Replaces the doc_id±1 contiguity_window approach.
assertions.evidence: 9 tests passing. use_event_frames parameter on recall() and _recall_retrieve()

assertions.text: LME 5-ctx eval with event frames scores >= 196/300 SubEM (no regression from baseline). run_engram.py --use_recall --faceted_cache qwen25 --event_frames flag.
assertions.evidence: 196/300 SubEM (65.33%). Per-ctx: 47,40,37,33,39. ctx1 +2, ctx0 -1, ctx2 -1, ctx3/4 unchanged. Output: 20260424_163537_engram_cs512_E25_ef_5ctx_longmemeval_s*_gpt-4o-mini.json
